questions.q: Someone's at the door. — That ___ the postman. He always comes at ten.
questions.why: *will be* — упевнене припущення про теперішнє з досвіду: *That'll be the postman.*

questions.q: Don't call her now. She ___ to bed.
questions.why: *will have* + третя форма — припущення про вже зроблене: *She'll have gone to bed.*

questions.q: The door ___ open. I think it's locked.
The car ___ start this morning, so I took a bus.
questions.why: *wouldn't* — відмова в минулому: *The car wouldn't start.*

questions.q: It's strange that she ___ say that. (дивно, що)
questions.why: *should* після оцінки (*strange, surprised*) передає саму думку про подію: *It's strange that she should say that.*

questions.q: ___ you need any help, just call me.
I ___ say it's about forty kilometres. (обережна думка)
___ I apologise? I did nothing wrong!
Every evening my grandfather ___ sit by the fire and tell stories.
Accidents ___ happen. Don't worry about it.
questions.why: *Accidents will happen* — так уже буває (також *can / do / may*).

questions.q: Take a coat in case it ___ rain. (малоймовірно)
questions.why: *in case it should rain* — ще менш імовірно.

questions.q: She ___ talk for hours if you let her. (типово для неї, зараз)
questions.why: *will* — характерна поведінка (*can, would* теж підходять за змістом).

questions.q: How ___ I know? I wasn't there!
questions.why: *How should I know?* (або *How would I know?*) — звідки мені знати.
*I would imagine* — обережна думка (*I can imagine* теж правильно).

answer: Should you have any questions please contact us
Please contact us should you have any questions
questions.why: *Should you have any questions…* — формальна умова.
questions.hint: Якщо у вас виникнуть запитання, звертайтеся.
